jd.title: Group GM / PM — Fraud & Risk
jd.description: Marqeta is hiring a Group GM/PM to own end-to-end fraud and risk product strategy across our card-issuing platform. You will define the roadmap for transaction monitoring, dispute lifecycle (TC40/SAFE), authorization risk scoring, and 3DS/SCA orchestration. You will partner with risk operations, data science, and engineering to ship ML-driven fraud detection that protects $250B+ TPV across our processor and program-manager customers. Outcomes: reduce net fraud loss as a % of TPV, improve approval rates, and shorten dispute resolution SLAs. Requirements: 8+ years PM experience, deep payments domain (issuer-side preferred), prior P&L or product-line ownership, comfort presenting to risk and finance leadership.

persona.voice: data-led, operator-flavoured, comfortable with risk vocabulary
